config.selection: lowest validation token-weighted cross entropy over fixed 25-update and epoch-end checkpoints; trained checkpoints only

limits: Synthetic macOS voices only; all voices recur across partitions.
Filtered STT clips, not multi-turn LLM training.
Fresh grouped, stratified split of a previously examined synthetic corpus; not a new unseen benchmark.
No actual-app result rendering, human-speech or iPhone acceptance is established by transcription scores.
visualReview: Not an app-command evaluation: no mathematical output is rendered. App visual acceptance remains incomplete (2/400 conversations in prior evidence).
metricNotes: Primary unique-transcript score; full retained-clip score secondary. V2 normalization canonicalizes cardinals, decimals and explicit operators; preserves wrong values/signs and ordinary words. Raw WER uses unnormalized whitespace words. Math-token error rate is diagnostic, not equation accuracy. Training curves are token-weighted cross entropy over each optimizer update (training mode/dropout); validation curves use fixed unique validation clips (evaluation mode). Generation timing excludes imports/model load/preprocessing; per-clip processing+generation and full run times are also recorded. Both rounds use one warm eager MPS pass with the same deterministic decoder.
